defmodule FirmwareAlert.Mailer do
  @moduledoc """
  Multi-tenant alert mailer for IoT device firmware.
  Sends device health notifications to tenant administrators.
  """

  require Logger

  @max_subject_length 128
  @allowed_header_chars ~r/^[\x20-\x7E]+$/

  defstruct [:tenant_id, :device_id, :alert_type, :message, :recipient]

  def send_alert(%__MODULE__{} = alert) do
    with :ok <- validate_tenant_isolation(alert),
         {:ok, headers} <- build_headers(alert),
         {:ok, body} <- build_body(alert) do
      dispatch_email(headers, body)
    end
  end

  defp validate_tenant_isolation(%{tenant_id: tid, device_id: did}) do
    case FirmwareAlert.TenantRegistry.device_belongs_to?(tid, did) do
      true -> :ok
      false -> {:error, :tenant_violation}
    end
  end

  defp build_headers(%{recipient: recipient, alert_type: type, device_id: device_id, tenant_id: tenant_id}) do
    subject = compose_subject(type, device_id)
    from = tenant_from_address(tenant_id)
    
    headers = %{
      "From" => from,
      "To" => sanitize_address(recipient),
      "Subject" => subject,
      "X-Tenant-ID" => to_string(tenant_id),
      "X-Device-ID" => to_string(device_id),
      "X-Mailer" => "FirmwareAlert/1.0",
      "MIME-Version" => "1.0",
      "Content-Type" => "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
    }

    {:ok, headers}
  end

  defp compose_subject(alert_type, device_id) do
    raw_subject = "[#{alert_type}] Device #{device_id} Alert"
    truncated = String.slice(raw_subject, 0, @max_subject_length)
    encode_header_value(truncated)
  end

  defp tenant_from_address(tenant_id) do
    domain = FirmwareAlert.TenantRegistry.get_domain(tenant_id)
    "alerts@#{domain}"
  end

  defp sanitize_address(address) when is_binary(address) do
    address
    |> String.trim()
    |> reject_if_contains_newlines()
  end

  defp reject_if_contains_newlines(addr) do
    if String.contains?(addr, ["\r", "\n"]) do
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid email address"
    else
      addr
    end
  end

  defp encode_header_value(value) when is_binary(value) do
    # RFC 2047 Q-encoding for non-ASCII, but we also need to handle
    # folding for long lines per RFC 5322
    value
    |> String.graphemes()
    |> Enum.map(&encode_grapheme/1)
    |> IO.iodata_to_binary()
  end

  defp encode_grapheme(char) do
    case :binary.first(char) do
      b when b in 0x20..0x7E -> char
      _ -> "=?UTF-8?Q?#{q_encode(char)}?="
    end
  end

  defp q_encode(str) do
    str
    |> :binary.bin_to_list()
    |> Enum.map(fn byte -> "=#{Integer.to_string(byte, 16) |> String.pad_leading(2, "0")}" end)
    |> Enum.join()
  end

  defp build_body(%{message: message, device_id: device_id, tenant_id: tenant_id}) do
    body = """
    IoT Device Alert Notification
    =============================
    Tenant: #{tenant_id}
    Device: #{device_id}
    
    #{message}
    
    --
    This is an automated message from FirmwareAlert system.
    """
    {:ok, body}
  end

  defp dispatch_email(headers, body) do
    raw_message = format_raw_message(headers, body)
    Logger.info("Dispatching alert email to #{headers["To"]}")
    FirmwareAlert.SMTPClient.send(raw_message)
  end

  defp format_raw_message(headers, body) do
    header_lines = Enum.map(headers, fn {k, v} -> "#{k}: #{v}" end)
    Enum.join(header_lines, "\r\n") <> "\r\n\r\n" <> body
  end
end

defmodule FirmwareAlert.TenantRegistry do
  @moduledoc "Registry for multi-tenant device management"

  def device_belongs_to?(tenant_id, device_id) do
    # In production, checks database
    case :ets.lookup(:tenant_devices, {tenant_id, device_id}) do
      [{_, true}] -> true
      _ -> false
    end
  end

  def get_domain(tenant_id) do
    case :ets.lookup(:tenant_config, tenant_id) do
      [{_, %{domain: domain}}] -> sanitize_domain(domain)
      _ -> "default.iot-alerts.local"
    end
  end

  defp sanitize_domain(domain) do
    # Validate domain format
    if Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9.\-]*[a-zA-Z0-9]$/, domain) do
      domain
    else
      "default.iot-alerts.local"
    end
  end
end

defmodule FirmwareAlert.DeviceController do
  @moduledoc "Handles incoming device telemetry and triggers alerts"

  def handle_telemetry(tenant_id, device_id, %{"type" => type, "payload" => payload}) do
    alert_type = classify_alert(type, payload)
    recipient = get_tenant_admin_email(tenant_id)
    # Device name comes from device registration, which allows Unicode names
    device_name = get_device_name(tenant_id, device_id)
    
    alert = %FirmwareAlert.Mailer{
      tenant_id: tenant_id,
      device_id: device_name,
      alert_type: alert_type,
      message: format_payload(payload),
      recipient: recipient
    }

    FirmwareAlert.Mailer.send_alert(alert)
  end

  defp classify_alert("temperature", %{"value" => v}) when v > 85, do: "CRITICAL"
  defp classify_alert("temperature", %{"value" => v}) when v > 70, do: "WARNING"
  defp classify_alert("battery", %{"value" => v}) when v < 10, do: "LOW_BATTERY"
  defp classify_alert(_, _), do: "INFO"

  defp get_tenant_admin_email(tenant_id) do
    case :ets.lookup(:tenant_config, tenant_id) do
      [{_, %{admin_email: email}}] -> email
      _ -> nil
    end
  end

  defp get_device_name(tenant_id, device_id) do
    case :ets.lookup(:device_names, {tenant_id, device_id}) do
      [{_, name}] -> name
      _ -> to_string(device_id)
    end
  end

  defp format_payload(payload) when is_map(payload) do
    payload
    |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} -> "  #{k}: #{inspect(v)}" end)
    |> Enum.join("\n")
  end
end
